text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- No indictment for Netanyahu, coalition intact
- Oppositioner Yossi Sarid to High Court: indict PM
- Large error in recording expenditures in budget led to inflated estimate of deficit
- Police recommend charges against Yedioth Ahronoth editor Arnon Moses over purchase of shares
- Finance Minister Dan Meridor deliberated but decided to stay in government
- Justice Minister Tsachi Hanegbi: As far as I'm concerned the case is closed
- Shas: For us this is a declaration of war
- Labour leader Shimon Peres: Netanyahu should resign for the sake of the state
- Yedioth poll: 58%: Netanyahu shouldn't resign, 56% Hanegbi should
- Attorney General Rubenstein: A gloomy picture
- Legal analysts: a severe report but Netanyahu does not have to quit
